# Data Source: identitynow_connector_customizer

Use this data source to look up a connector customizer by ID or name. Lookups by name list all customizers and match the name exactly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_connector_customizer" "custom" {
  name = "My Connector Customizer"
}
```

Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Connector customizer ID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Connector customizer name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `image_id` (String) Current image ID of the customizer.
- `image_version` (Number) Current image version of the customizer.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID of the customizer.
